email_subject: Application - Specialist Client Operations at Wavemaker
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Specialist Client Operations role at Wavemaker. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web project coordination, I am eager to bring my organisational skills and attention to detail to your client operations team.

In my current role at Episto, I manage multiple client websites, coordinating tasks from keyword research to publishing, and ensuring deadlines and budgets are met. I work closely with internal teams and external partners, maintaining accurate records and supporting campaign administration. My experience with CRM systems and performance reporting tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush has given me a strong foundation in operational processes.

I am proactive, solution-oriented, and comfortable working with numbers and planning tools. I communicate professionally in English and am improving my Dutch (B1), with a willingness to learn French. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to Wavemaker's dynamic environment and grow within the media industry.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Specialist Client Operations position at Wavemaker. Your emphasis on smooth campaign delivery and operational excellence resonates with my experience in digital marketing and project coordination. I am confident that my organisational skills and proactive approach can support your client teams effectively.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage the day-to-day operations for multiple client websites, from initial briefing to final reporting. I coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure deadlines are met, budgets are tracked, and administrative tasks are completed accurately. For a cleaning-services client, I maintain CRM records and follow-up, ensuring that all operational details are up to date. This hands-on experience has taught me the importance of clear communication and meticulous attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

I have also developed strong technical skills in SEO, content management, and web development, which allow me to understand the full lifecycle of media campaigns. I am comfortable working with numbers, planning tools, and administrative systems, and I am always looking for ways to improve processes. My ability to work in English and Turkish, along with my improving Dutch (B1), positions me to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders. I am eager to learn French and further expand my language skills.

I am drawn to Wavemaker's collaborative culture and commitment to innovation. I am curious about the media industry and motivated to learn how campaigns are planned, bought, activated, and reported. I am a quick learner, not afraid to ask questions, and I thrive in dynamic environments where teamwork is essential.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
